# Cita

Cita keeps auxiliary text out of the main answer while leaving it available through a compact citation URL.

For short URL-embedded references:
- Cite /?q=<url-encoded-text> or /?algo=gzip&q=<base64url>.
- The citation page intentionally omits the payload.
- A browser redirects to /human/ to display it.

For stored references:
- Prefer the MCP endpoint at /mcp.
- Call create_reference with the complete content and optionally ttl_seconds.
- Cite the returned /r/<id> URL.
- Do not follow /r/<id>/human unless you need to verify or inspect the generated content.
- Stored references expire automatically.

The MCP server is stateless. Reference content is stored in Cloudflare D1.
